name: doctrine-shame-shift
notes: P6 doctrinal shame gate: force focus=Raider, then inject four months of lopsided exchanges (30 alien ships lost vs 5 destroyed per month) through the same ledger battles fill. Expect shame to climb ~0.3/month and the focus to be abandoned for another (opposite temperament preferred) after ~4 months, with the dials following. Real battles almost never go this badly in the fixture chapters (aliens decline bad fights), so natural shifts are judged from soaks; doctrine-raider and doctrine-bastion assert no shift without injections. Recalibrated 2026-10-18: the current build's aliens destroy many more human ships in real battles, so 30:5 injections left the loss share at 0.58-0.62 by October and shame plateaued at 0.97; now 40:3.
asserts: events('doctrine', ev='shifted')[0]['dials']['MaxRaidGoals'] != events('doctrine', ev='forced')[-1]['dials']['MaxRaidGoals'] or events('doctrine', ev='shifted')[0]['dials']['MaxCaptureGoals'] != events('doctrine', ev='forced')[-1]['dials']['MaxCaptureGoals']
info: [(e['t'], e['focus'], round(e['before'], 2), round(e['after'], 2), e['lossShare']) for e in events('shame')]
[(e['t'], e['from'], e['to'], e['why']) for e in events('doctrine', ev='shifted')]
events('doctrine', ev='shifted')[0]['dials'] if count('doctrine', ev='shifted') else None
